This means even in the non-sync path it will silently inject a literal placeholder when `refresh_token` is absent (or optional), potentially persisting a bogus refresh token and masking token-refresh failures. The finding matches the diff-grounded behavior and the suggested limitation to the sync branch is consistent with the comment that sync responses may omit refresh tokens.
